description: Animation steps 1 and 2 correspond to the two before-deletion columns of the connection table. The last step corresponds to the two after-deletion columns. Use the node row headings to look up the connections in either state.

steps.announcement: Follow the left branch to target node 2 and its parent, 4.
steps.explanation: The target 2 is less than 8 and 4. Follow 8→4→2 to reach cur=2 with pre=4. Node 4 currently has left child 2 and right child 6. Node 2 has no left child and has right leaf 3. No deletion has taken place. For the whole tree, see the two before-deletion columns in “Binary search tree connections before and after deleting a node with one child.”
steps.key_state: With cur = 2 and pre = 4, child 3 is still attached to the right of 2.
steps.title: Locate target 2 and parent 4

steps.announcement: Confirm that target node 2 has just one child, its right child 3.
steps.explanation: Check that cur (2) has degree 1 and its only child is 3 on the right. To delete 2, reconnect 3 to the parent. Simply clearing 4.left would lose this connection. So far only the check is complete: pre=4, node 4 still has left child 2 and right child 6, and 2 still has right child 3. The whole tree still matches the two before-deletion columns of the same table.
steps.key_state: Node 2 has degree 1 and its only child is its right child, 3. Parent 4 still has left child 2. Deletion has yet to occur.
steps.title: Confirm that 3 is the only child

steps.announcement: Attach the only child, 3, to the left of parent 4 to finish deleting node 2.
steps.explanation: Set pre.left = cur.right so that 4.left points directly to 3, bypassing and detaching 2. The root is still 8, and 4 now has left leaf 3 and right child 6. All other connections stay the same, preserving values 3 through 15. The whole tree matches the two after-deletion columns of the same table, with node 2 marked “Removed.” Only a reference has changed. Node 3 is still the same object.
steps.key_state: With 4.left = 3, node 4 now has left child 3 and right child 6. Node 2 has been detached.
steps.title: Reconnect node 3 to the parent

prose.summary: To delete a node of degree 1, redirect its parent's reference from the target to the target's only child.
